adapter.operation: store_blob/load_blob only; no snapshot, capture, CAS or ref update

limits: Opaque engineering custody only; no Lean/runtime/filesystem/hash/compression/permission/transaction refinement.
Captured failures/statuses remain historical observations; storing them does not rerun checks or confer current verification.
Patch bytes are passive and must never be automatically applied to nonmatching preimages.
scope: Only source-intent referenced artifacts inside the one bounded ignored integration scratch tree; exact authored pre/postimages, owned patch, captured check logs/reviews and154 retained renderer projections. Original logical IDs and authored/rejected status distinctions retained. No native receipt JSON copied.
